roomTypes.name: Standard Room
roomTypes.shortDescription: A calm, well-kept room with everything you need for a night or a working week in Akure.
roomTypes.description: Our Standard Room is the simplest way to stay at Selems without giving up comfort. A queen-size bed with a grey tufted headboard, crisp white linen, an armchair and a bedside table set the tone. The room is air-conditioned, has a smart TV with Netflix and YouTube, and fast Wi-Fi for calls and streaming. Room service runs 24 hours, and the front office is always open if you arrive late. A good choice for solo business travellers and couples on a short stay.

images.alt: Standard Room with grey tufted headboard at Selems Hotel, Akure

roomTypes.name: Business Room
roomTypes.shortDescription: Set up for working trips: a proper desk, fast Wi-Fi and a quiet room to sleep in.
roomTypes.description: The Business Room is built around the working day. Alongside a comfortable bed with a padded headboard and reading lamps on both sides, you get a desk and chair for laptop work, high-speed Wi-Fi for video meetings, and a smart TV to switch off with in the evening. Room service is available at any hour, so a late dinner after meetings in Alagbaka or at FUTA is never a problem.

images.alt: Business Room with padded headboard and bedside lamps

roomTypes.seoTitle: Business Room in Akure — ₦40,000/night | Selems Hotel
roomTypes.seoDescription: A quiet room with a work desk and fast Wi-Fi for business trips to Akure. Smart TV, 24/7 room service. Reserve now, pay at the hotel.

roomTypes.name: Deluxe Room
roomTypes.shortDescription: Warm tan leather, a statement headboard and a little more room to relax.
roomTypes.description: The Deluxe Room brings warmth to the Selems palette with a tan leather headboard, matching accent chair and soft white bedding. There is space to unpack properly and relax after a long drive into Akure. As in every room, you have air conditioning, a smart TV with streaming apps, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service, with the restaurant and bars a short walk downstairs.

images.alt: Deluxe Room with tan leather headboard and accent chair

roomTypes.seoTitle: Deluxe Room in Akure — ₦45,000/night | Selems Hotel

roomTypes.name: Executive
roomTypes.shortDescription: A bedroom with its own sitting corner in mint velvet, for longer stays.
roomTypes.description: The Executive adds a proper sitting area to the bedroom: two mint velvet armchairs and a low table where you can take a call, read, or have breakfast brought up. It suits guests staying several nights who want more than a bed and a desk. Air conditioning, a smart TV, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service are all included.

images.alt: Executive room seating area with mint velvet armchairs

roomTypes.seoTitle: Executive Room in Akure — ₦50,000/night | Selems Hotel
roomTypes.seoDescription: Executive room with a velvet sitting area, smart TV and free Wi-Fi in Akure. Ideal for longer stays. Reserve online, pay at the hotel.

roomTypes.name: Executive Double
roomTypes.shortDescription: A bedroom plus a lounge with sofas and a large TV, for guests who receive visitors.
roomTypes.description: The Executive Double pairs the bedroom with a lounge furnished with sage sofas, a coffee table and a large wall-mounted smart TV. It is the room to choose if you expect visitors, want to watch a match in comfort, or simply prefer not to spend the evening on the bed. Free Wi-Fi, air conditioning and round-the-clock room service come as standard.

images.alt: Executive Double lounge with sage sofas and wall-mounted smart TV

roomTypes.seoTitle: Executive Double in Akure — ₦55,000/night | Selems Hotel
roomTypes.seoDescription: Executive Double with a lounge, sofas and large smart TV in Ijapo Extension, Akure. Free Wi-Fi and 24/7 room service. Pay at the hotel.

roomTypes.name: Diplomatic Suite
roomTypes.shortDescription: A private, comfortable suite for officials and visitors who need to work and receive guests.
roomTypes.description: Designed for dignitaries and visitors on official business, the Diplomatic Suite combines a restful bedroom with a lounge for receiving guests and a desk with an ergonomic chair for work. High-speed Wi-Fi keeps meetings running smoothly, and the front office can arrange anything you need at any hour. Privacy, quiet and attentive service are the point of this suite.

images.alt: Diplomatic Suite living area with armchairs and coffee table

roomTypes.seoTitle: Diplomatic Suite in Akure — ₦60,000/night | Selems Hotel
roomTypes.seoDescription: A private suite in Akure with lounge, desk and ergonomic chair, high-speed Wi-Fi and 24/7 service. Ideal for official visits. Pay at the hotel.

roomTypes.name: Royal Suite
roomTypes.shortDescription: A grand upholstered bed, soft grey tones and space to unwind.
roomTypes.description: The Royal Suite is centred on a tall upholstered headboard in soft grey, dressed in white linen and framed by bedside lamps. With a separate lounge, there is room to spread out over a long weekend or a family occasion in Akure. It includes everything the hotel offers as standard: air conditioning, a smart TV, free Wi-Fi and room service around the clock.

roomTypes.name: VIP Suite
roomTypes.shortDescription: Green velvet, a separate lounge and our most requested suite for special stays.
roomTypes.description: The VIP Suite opens with a deep green velvet headboard and white bedding, then continues into a separate lounge with sofas and a large smart TV. It suits guests staying several nights, couples marking an occasion, or anyone who wants to receive visitors without sitting on the bed. A work desk, fast Wi-Fi, air conditioning and 24-hour room service complete the suite.

roomTypes.name: Penthouse
roomTypes.shortDescription: Our most private suite, with a lounge and mood lighting for the evening.
roomTypes.description: The Penthouse is set apart from the comings and goings of the hotel, for guests who want the most private stay Selems offers. Adjustable mood lighting changes the room from bright and practical in the day to calm and atmospheric at night, and the lounge gives you space to relax or receive a guest. With a smart TV with streaming apps, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service, it is the suite we suggest for celebrations, anniversaries and longer stays in Akure.

faqs.question: What time are check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: The front office is open 24 hours, so you can arrive at any time of day or night. Call or WhatsApp us if you would like to arrange an early check-in or late check-out.

faqs.question: Do I have to pay when I book online?
faqs.answer: No. Your room is reserved as soon as you confirm, and you pay at the front desk when you arrive, by cash, bank transfer or card.

faqs.question: Is there parking at the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parking is free in the hotel's gated, lit forecourt.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the “Manage or cancel your booking” link in your confirmation email, or call or WhatsApp the front office and we will help.

faqs.question: Do you serve food at night?
faqs.answer: Yes. Room service runs 24 hours a day.

faqs.question: Is there Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes, free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

faqs.question: What is the best area to stay in Akure?
faqs.answer: For a quiet stay with easy access to the whole city, Ijapo Estate and its extension are a good choice. For government business, Alagbaka is closest.

fields.h1: Where to stay in Akure: a visitor's guide
fields.author: [CONFIRM] Name, role
fields.intro: Which part of the city suits your trip, how to get here, and what to see while you are in town. Written by the team at Selems Exclusive Hotel & Suites.

sections.heading: Akure at a glance
sections.body: Akure is the capital of Ondo State in south-west Nigeria. Most visitors come for government business, the Federal University of Technology (FUTA), weddings and family events, or as a base for Idanre Hills. The city is compact, so where you stay mostly decides how quiet your nights are and how long your morning drive takes.

sections.heading: Best areas to stay in Akure

areas.name: Alagbaka
areas.body: The government district. Close to the State Secretariat and ministries; best for official visits.

areas.name: Ijapo Estate and Extension
areas.body: Residential and quiet, with good road access across the city. Selems is here.

areas.name: Oba-Ile
areas.body: Near Akure Airport. Handy for early flights.

areas.name: FUTA axis
areas.body: For convocations, conferences and campus visits.

sections.heading: Getting to Akure
sections.body: [CONFIRM] Airlines serving Akure Airport, road times from Lagos and Ibadan, and whether the hotel arranges airport pickup.

sections.heading: What to see nearby
sections.body: Idanre Hills, a short drive from the city, is the best-known sight in the state: a climb of several hundred steps to an old hilltop settlement with wide views. In town, the Deji of Akure's palace and the Oja Oba market beside it are worth an afternoon.

sections.heading: Booking tips
sections.body: Weekends with weddings and university convocations fill up fast, so book early for those dates. You can reserve online and pay at the front desk when you arrive.

privacy.seoTitle: Privacy notice | Selems Exclusive Hotel & Suites, Akure
privacy.seoDescription: How Selems Exclusive Hotel & Suites in Akure collects, uses and protects the personal data you give us when you book or contact us.

fields.intro: This notice explains what personal data Selems Exclusive Hotel & Suites collects when you book a room or contact us through this website, why we use it, and the rights you have under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Selems Exclusive Hotel & Suites, Atibiti Layout, Ijapo Extension, Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria, is responsible for the personal data described here. You can contact us about it at info@selemsexclusivehotel.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
When you book: your name, email address, phone number, dates of stay, room, number of guests, and anything you choose to tell us, such as your expected arrival time, the purpose of your stay or special requests.

When you send a message: your name, email address, phone number if you give it, and your message.

To keep the booking and contact forms safe from abuse, our systems also record the internet (IP) address a request comes from. We use analytics cookies only if you agree to them.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body:
We use your details to make and manage your booking, to send you booking emails (confirmation, changes, cancellation and a reminder before you arrive), to reply to your messages, and to prevent fraud and misuse of the website.

After your stay we may send one email asking about your experience. You can ignore it, and you can ask us not to send it.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that run this website and send our emails on our behalf, under contract and only for these purposes, and with authorities where the law requires it.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep booking records for 24 months after your stay, and messages for 24 months after we receive them. After that we delete or anonymise them, unless the law requires us to keep them longer.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us for a copy of your personal data, to correct it, to delete it, or to stop using it for a particular purpose, and you can withdraw consent you have given at any time. Email info@selemsexclusivehotel.com and we will respond as the law requires. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.

fields.intro: These terms apply to rooms booked on this website. Booking online reserves your room straight away; you pay at the hotel.

sections.heading: Your reservation
sections.body: Each online booking reserves one room for the dates you choose. Prices are per room, per night, in naira, and the total shown when you book is the amount due. You pay at the front desk on arrival, by cash, bank transfer or card.

sections.heading: Checking in
sections.body: Please bring a valid photo ID for the guest named on the booking. The front office is open 24 hours, so you can arrive at any time.

sections.heading: Changing your booking
sections.body: To change your dates or room, call or WhatsApp the front office with your booking reference. Changes depend on availability and may change the price.

sections.heading: Group and event bookings
sections.body: For several rooms, weddings, burials, convocations or conferences, contact us through the contact page or WhatsApp and we will reply with availability and a group rate.
